steps.title: Collect wastewater sample
steps.instruction: Obtain sterile collection bottles (2 L for grab, ≥5 L for composite). For grab samples, attach a 2 L bottle to hose clamps and two 1/8‑inch chain hooks, lower into the sewer, fill, then spray bottle, chains, and any spill area with clean tap water followed by 99.5 % isopropanol. For composite samples, place a ≥5 L bottle in an autosampler, run the program, then rinse the exterior with clean water and spray with 99.5 % isopropanol before capping.

steps.title: Split sample into two containers
steps.instruction: Pour the collected wastewater into two sterile 500 mL plastic bottles inside a 5‑gallon bucket: Container 1 receives 0.5 mL of 100 g L⁻¹ sodium thiosulfate (prepared from GrowingLabs sodium thiosulfate, catalog LC250001) to give 0.1 g L⁻¹ chlorine neutralizer; Container 2 is left without additive for field water‑quality measurements. Label both containers with a permanent paint pen (ULINE, catalog S‑20622). Strain the wastewater through a 2–3 mm kitchen‑type strainer (Bradshaw Home, catalog 72115) placed in a wide‑mouth funnel (Walmart, catalog HTFF‑2020) into the bucket, rinse the strainer and funnel with DI water (Thermo Fisher, catalog 15230001), return solids to the sewer, and disinfect strainer and funnel with 99.5 % isopropanol spray.

steps.title: Transport and field measurements
steps.instruction: Place Container 1 on ice or frozen ice packs in a cooler for transport to the laboratory. Using Container 2, measure pH, specific conductivity, dissolved oxygen, and temperature with a pre‑disinfected, calibrated YSI probe (pH standards 4, 7, 10; Cole‑Parmer, catalog UX‑05942‑10). Record the data, discard the remaining wastewater back into the sewer, rinse the probe and bucket with clean water, and disinfect both with 99.5 % isopropanol spray. (Only pH is required for downstream RNA workflow.)

steps.title: Laboratory receipt and volume adjustment
steps.instruction: In a BSL‑2 hood, wear a lab coat, gloves, disposable face mask, long pants, closed‑toe shoes, and tie back hair. Homogenize Container 1 by shaking, then level the volume to exactly 500 mL. If >500 mL, pour excess into a sterile 100 mL PYREX beaker (Millipore Sigma, catalog CLS1000100‑12EA), then discard the excess wastewater. Autoclave the beaker after use. Keep the sample on ice until further processing.

steps.title: Prepare OC43 viral recovery control
steps.instruction: Grow Vero cells (ATCC CCL‑81) in a T75 flask to 50 % confluence. Infect with OC43 (ATCC VR‑1558) at MOI 0.01 in 12 mL RPMI‑1640 (Thermo Fisher, catalog 12633012) containing 10 % fetal bovine serum, rocking for 1.5 h at room temperature. Add another 12 mL RPMI and incubate 37 °C overnight. Next day replace media with fresh 12 mL RPMI and incubate 37 °C for 4 days. Filter the supernatant through a Pall 0.45‑µm filter unit, extract total RNA from 50 µL aliquots (four replicates) using the Zymo Quick‑RNA Viral Kit (R1034/1035), quantify genomic copies by absolute qPCR, and make aliquots sufficient to spike 10–100 µL per day of samples. Heat‑inactivate aliquots at 56 °C for 15 min (heat block). Spike each wastewater sample to achieve 1 × 10⁶ gc L⁻¹, mix, and disinfect the bottle and hood surface with 99.5 % isopropanol.

steps.title: Prepare M. smegmatis bacterial control
steps.instruction: Streak Mycobacterium smegmatis mc²155 (NIH AIDS Reagent Program, catalog 2195) onto LB agar (Thermo Fisher, catalog 22700025) containing 100 µg mL⁻¹ ampicillin (Millipore Sigma, catalog A5354‑10ML) and incubate 37 °C for 3 days. Inoculate a single colony into 50 mL LB broth (Thermo Fisher, catalog 10855001) with 0.05 % Tween 80 (Millipore Sigma, catalog P1754‑25ML) and 100 µg mL⁻¹ ampicillin; grow 37 °C with shaking for 30 h. Harvest at OD₆₀₀ ≈ 1.0 (≈1 × 10⁸ cells mL⁻¹) and calculate genomic copies per µL. Spike wastewater to 2 × 10⁶ gc L⁻¹, mix, and disinfect the bottle and hood surface with 99.5 % isopropanol.

steps.title: Add biological controls to sample
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube containing the OC43 and M. smegmatis aliquots, add the calculated volumes to the 500 mL wastewater sample, close the bottle, and shake to homogenize.

steps.title: Add MgCl₂ and stir bar
steps.instruction: Add magnesium chloride (51 % w/v MgCl₂, RICCA Chemical, catalog 4470) to reach a final concentration of 50 mM (9.4 mL of the 51 % solution per L; for 500 mL add 4.7 mL). Place an autoclaved 12 mm × 3 mm magnetic stir bar (VWR, catalog 58948‑091) into the bottle and stir on a magnetic stir plate.

steps.title: Adjust sample pH
steps.instruction: Insert a pre‑calibrated pH probe (using pH standards 4, 7, 10; Cole‑Parmer, catalog UX‑05942‑10) and record the initial pH. Using a sterile glass dropper (Fisher, catalog 14‑955‑502), add drops of 10 % HCl (Spectrum Chemical, catalog HY105) until the pH reaches 3.5–4.5. Record the number of drops and final pH, then close the bottle and shake to homogenize.

steps.title: Set up vacuum filtration apparatus
steps.instruction: Attach a sterile Pall magnetic filter cup holder (Weber Scientific, catalog EF8452B for 300 mL or EF8452F for 500 mL) to the Vactrap 2 vacuum trap system (VWR, catalog 76207‑602). Place a sterile membrane filter in the cup: MCE 0.45 µm (Millipore Sigma, catalog HAWP04700) for RNA (electronegative filtration) or GN‑6 Metricel 0.45 µm (New Star Environmental, catalog 66278) for DNA (vacuum filtration). Secure the magnetic top cup, turn on the vacuum, and open the manifold.

steps.title: Filter wastewater sample
steps.instruction: Using a sterile 100 mL graduated cylinder (Carolina, catalog 721603), add the wastewater to the Pall cup in increments until the membrane is saturated and flow ceases. Record the total volume filtered.

steps.title: Collect and store filter membrane
steps.instruction: Remove the magnetic top cup and, with sterile forceps (AmScope, catalog TW‑487) that have been autoclaved, handle the membrane. For DNA: cut the membrane in half with a sterile scalpel (S6012‑50), fold each half twice, and place each half into a 2 mL Zymo ZR BashingBead tube (0.1 & 0.5 mm beads, catalog S6012‑50) containing 1 mL 1× DNA/RNA Shield (Zymo, catalog R1100‑250) or into a 5 mL 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube as backup. For RNA: fold the whole membrane three times and place it into a 5 mL 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube containing 2 mL 1× DNA/RNA Shield (use 1.5 mL only if performing RNA‑only workflow).

steps.title: Store filter concentrates
steps.instruction: Refrigerate the tubes (5 mL Eppendorf tube for RNA, 2 mL BashingBead tube for DNA) at 4 °C. This step can be paused for up to 24 h; perform all extractions within that window. Autoclave all filtration equipment (Pall cups, forceps, graduated cylinders, stir bars) after each sample.

steps.title: RNA extraction from concentrate
steps.instruction: In a BSL‑2 hood, wear PPE and decontaminate surfaces with 70 % ethanol. Vortex the RNA tube briefly, spin down, and transfer 400 µL of concentrate to a new 1.7 mL microcentrifuge tube. Add 800 µL viral RNA buffer (2:1 ratio, Zymo Quick‑RNA Viral Kit) and mix. Load 600 µL onto a Zymo‑Spin IC column, centrifuge 13,000 × g for 2 min, discard flowthrough. Wash twice with 660 µL viral wash buffer (30 s each), then add 660 µL 100 % ethanol and centrifuge 1 min. Elute with 100 µL nuclease‑free water (for comparison with DNA workflow) or with 10 µL for RNA‑only analysis. For inhibition control, add 30 µL HIV‑1 RNA (≈100 copies µL⁻¹; IDT) to the eluate; also prepare a no‑inhibition control with 30 µL HIV‑1 RNA + 10 µL water. Optional inhibitor removal: prepare a Zymo‑Spin III‑HRC column, add 600 µL OneStep PCR Inhibitor Removal prep‑solution (Zymo, catalog D6030), centrifuge 8,000 × g 3 min, place column into a fresh 1.7 mL tube, transfer 100 µL RNA eluate onto it, centrifuge 16,000 × g 3 min. Keep purified RNA on ice; pause point – store at –80 °C.

steps.title: DNA extraction from concentrate
steps.instruction: Place the 2 mL ZR BashingBead tube (half‑membrane) into an OMNI Bead‑Ruptor 12 and run 1 min beating, 5 min rest, repeat for a total of 3 cycles (18 min). Centrifuge 12,000 × g for 1 min, transfer 400 µL supernatant to a Zymo‑Spin III‑F filter (ZymoBIOMICS DNA Miniprep kit, catalog D4300) in a clean collection tube, centrifuge 8,000 × g for 1 min, discard flowthrough. Continue with the kit protocol, starting with 1,200 µL DNA binding buffer. Pause point – store extracted DNA at –20 °C.

steps.title: Volcano 2nd‑Generation qPCR (RNA)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 40 µL reaction master mix per sample (+2 extra reactions) as follows: 23.6 µL nuclease‑free water, 8.8 µL 1.1× Volcano buffer (from 5× stock), 0.8 µL 10 mM dNTPs (Thermo Fisher, catalog R0193), 0.4 µL Volcano2G polymerase (2 U, Thermo Fisher, catalog 12223012), 0.2 µL anti‑Taq antibody (2 U, TaKaRa, catalog 9002A), 1.0 µL 20 µM forward primer (500 nM final), 1.0 µL reverse primer (500 nM), 0.1 µL 100 µM probe (250 nM, FAM or HEX), 0.1 µL 400× ROX (Thermo Fisher, catalog 12223012). Vortex, spin, dispense 36 µL into each well of a 96‑well Bio‑Rad hard‑shell plate (catalog HSP9601). Add 4 µL RNA sample (or water for NTC, or 4 µL standard spanning 10¹–10⁵ copies µL⁻¹). Seal with Bio‑Rad Microseal “B” (catalog MSB1001), spin 15 s, and run on a CFX Connect with the following program (for SARS‑CoV‑2, OC43, HIV, SIV, B2M): 88 °C 30 s; 45 cycles of 88 °C 5 s, 60 °C 20 s (or 15 s for some targets), 72 °C 15 s. For Mpox (DNA) use 95 °C 1 min, then 45 cycles of 95 °C 10 s, 60 °C 20 s, 72 °C 15 s. Convert Cq values to gc L⁻¹ by correcting for the 4 µL input, the volume of 1× DNA/RNA Shield used, and the original wastewater volume (account for half‑ vs. full‑membrane).

steps.title: qPCR for DNA targets
steps.instruction: Prepare a 30 µL reaction master mix per sample (+2 extra) as follows: 15 µL 2× TaqMan Fast Universal PCR master mix (Thermo Fisher, catalog 4352042), 0.75 µL 20 µM forward primer (500 nM), 0.75 µL reverse primer (500 nM), 0.075 µL 100 µM probe (250 nM, FAM or HEX), 8.5 µL nuclease‑free water. Vortex, spin, dispense 25 µL into each well of a 96‑well plate. Add 5 µL DNA sample (or water for NTC, or 5 µL standard spanning 10¹–10⁵ copies µL⁻¹). Seal, spin 30 s, and run on CFX Connect: 95 °C 2 min; 40 cycles of 95 °C 10 s, 61 °C 25 s. Convert Cq to gc L⁻¹ using the 5 µL input volume, the volume of 1× DNA/RNA Shield, and the original wastewater volume (consider half‑ vs. full‑membrane).
